note: Representative subset of test procedures — not the full WSTG.

controls.title: Testing for weak lockout mechanism
controls.requirement: Determine whether the account lockout mechanism mitigates brute force.
expected_evidence: repeated failed logins trigger lockout/throttling (observed status/delay)
controls.limits: does not test credential-stuffing with valid-but-leaked creds

controls.title: Testing for SQL injection
controls.requirement: Identify SQL injection points and assess exploitability.
preconditions: user input reaches a database query
expected_evidence: a parameter alters query results / error-based or boolean inference proven
controls.limits: blind time-based testing may be rate-limited in prod

controls.title: Enumerate admin interfaces
controls.requirement: Identify hidden administrator interfaces and functionality.
preconditions: the app is reachable over HTTP
expected_evidence: admin path discovered and its access control observed
controls.limits: authenticated admin logic tested under ATHZ
